headline: Querétaro Industry and Commerce See Potential in Relation with China
summary: Querétaro attracted 2.5% of Chinese imports in August. Mexico's imports from China are mainly machinery parts and accessories, while its main export to China is copper minerals and concentrates.
why: Mexico's trade with China shapes manufacturing supply chains and the country's dependence on commodity exports such as copper.
original_headline: Industria y comercio de Querétaro ven potencial en relación con China
